description: Register the merchant with Stripe Tax for a jurisdiction they actually hold a registration in — this is what makes tax get charged there. A registration is a legal declaration, so confirm with the merchant first. Common cases: NZ/AU GST -> type 'standard'; a non-EU seller into the EU -> type 'oss_non_union' with country = their OSS country of identification (one registration covers all of Europe); a US state -> type 'state_sales_tax' with the 2-letter state. Requires Stripe Tax to be activated first (activate_tax).

active_from.description: ISO date the registration is effective from; defaults to today

country.description: ISO country, e.g. NZ — or the EU member state of OSS identification

name: add_tax_registration
title: Add a tax registration
